rationale: Lineage is now a public REIT, but the current SEC proxy supports a continuing private BGLH-linked Stonepeak economic interest and contractual rights. Stonepeak was a minority investor rather than the sole owner, while Bay Grove remained the controlling sponsor. The record should preserve the 2018 private ownership period, remove sole-owner status, add Bay Grove control and distinguish the qualifying transitional private interest from nonqualifying ordinary public shares.
recommendedChanges: Keep one canonical Lineage, Inc. record covering Lineage OP, LP and Lineage Logistics Holdings, LLC; treat BGLH as an ownership vehicle rather than a separate PortCo.
Correct Stonepeak from sole owner to a minority investor beginning May 2018 through Stonepeak Infrastructure Fund III AIV and Aspen co-investment vehicles.
Add Bay Grove as the controlling sponsor from the platform's 2008 formation.
Preserve Stonepeak as active only for its continuing private BGLH-linked economics and rights; do not treat any ordinary public common exposure as qualifying infrastructure ownership.
Record the July 26, 2024 IPO and issuer-only share sale, the post-IPO BGLH distributions and the 2026 reduction below the 25% attribution threshold.
Schedule a July 26, 2027 review and retire Stonepeak when the private BGLH or OP economics and related rights end or become only ordinary public common.
unresolvedQuestions: The exact 2018 Stonepeak security class and percentage were not publicly disclosed.
Stonepeak's exact 2026 BGLH percentage and receipt of 2024-2025 distributions were not publicly disclosed.
The final BGLH settlement and rights-termination date is unresolved, but current private economics and rights are directly supported.
linkedFollowUpSubjects: Lineage ownership review on or before 2027-07-26
